scenes.heading: Hook
scenes.narration: Want to store many values in one place? Python lists do exactly that. Let me show you in under a minute. Stay with me, this is quick and simple.

scenes.heading: What is a list
scenes.narration: A list holds many values in order. Think of it like a row of lunch boxes. Each box has a number, starting from zero. You can open any box by its number.

scenes.heading: Make one
scenes.narration: To make a list, use square brackets. Put values inside and separate them with commas. Then print the list to see all values at once. It is that simple.

scenes.heading: Outro
scenes.narration: That is a list. You store many values, and you read them by index. Try making your own list today. Full lesson ke liye link dekho, and see you next short.
